name: Pei-er
source:
Pei-er is a young housemaid who was just starting to adjust to her new life when it turns upside down one day.
After waking up from a long slumber, she is determined to return to her old life, and to find that precious person she left behind.
Pei-er is illiterate but she does her best to navigate her way through this confusing world.
[From [url=https://marie-marie.itch.io/one-last-goodbye]itch.io[/url]]
